episodes.synopsis: Chirico Cuvie is reunited with others from the Red Shoulder unit as they pursue their revenge against Yoran Pailsen. Unknown to them, Yoran and his group have created the Perfect Soldier, Ypsilon.
episodes.title: The Last Red Shoulder

episodes.synopsis: Chirico finds his beloved Fiana held hostage by Bararant in an experimental facility near Koba City, and he and his comrades have to fight their way in to save her.
episodes.title: Big Battle

episodes.synopsis: Chirico Cuvie has been assigned to a new unit, the Red Shoulder division. His selection is not an accident, as he has an ability that possibly makes him the ultimate soldier. The Red Shoulder unit is callous and merciless in their training, and will test Chirico's ability to the limit.
episodes.title: Red Shoulder Document - Yabou no Roots

episodes.synopsis: Chirico meets up with Gotho and friends at an oasis town for the first time in over 30 years.
episodes.title: Alone Again
